engagements.title: Delegation Strategy Session
engagements.objective: Align the delegation on red lines, priorities and division of labour before the high-level segment opens.

counterpart.name: Singapore delegation
counterpart.publicBackground: Internal coordination meeting; not on the public record.

sayThis: Confirm the three priorities: mitigation ambition, Article 6 operational rules, and adaptation support for partners.
Restate the red line: no new quantified finance commitments beyond the approved envelope.
Assign leads for each negotiating track and set the evening report-back time.
engagements.watchPoint: Don't let the session reopen settled internal positions — this is for direction, not debate.
engagements.ifAsked: Track leads hold delegated authority within the agreed mandate; escalate anything beyond it to the Minister.

anticipated.q: If finance talks stall, is there flexibility on the timing of disbursement language?
anticipated.why: Finance is expected to be the week's crunch point and officials will want a fallback; the mandate fixes the envelope but is silent on sequencing.

consider.text: Envelope is fixed; sequencing/timing may be explored at officials level without new commitment.
Any movement returns to the Minister before it is tabled.

anticipated.q: How should the delegation handle media approaches during the week?
anticipated.why: High-visibility week; consistent lines prevent mixed messaging across the team.

consider.text: All media routed through the approved doorstop lines; no freelancing.

publicInfo.text: Singapore's public COP31 priorities centre on practical implementation, high-integrity carbon markets and support for the region.

engagements.title: National Statement — High-Level Segment
engagements.objective: Deliver Singapore's national statement: ambitious, implementable, and partnership-focused.

counterpart.name: All delegations
counterpart.publicBackground: Open, broadcast session; all statements are on the public record.

sayThis: Open by welcoming the presidency's leadership and progress since COP30. (deliver warmly)
State Singapore's commitment to net zero by 2050 and to high-integrity carbon markets. (deliver exactly)
Call for outcomes that are ambitious and implementable for small and developing states.
Reaffirm Singapore's support to regional partners on adaptation and capacity.
engagements.watchPoint: Do not deviate from the cleared text on the net-zero and carbon-market lines.
engagements.ifAsked: Detailed positions are for the negotiating tracks; the statement reflects Singapore's settled national position.

anticipated.q: Will Singapore raise its 2030 target?
anticipated.why: Media and NGOs press all speakers on headline ambition; the statement mentions 2050 but not a revised 2030 figure.

consider.text: Stay with the cleared NDC language; no new target announced here.
Public commentary is pushing all parties for stronger 2030 numbers (indicative).

anticipated.q: Is Singapore's net-zero pledge conditional?
anticipated.why: The credibility of pledges is a running public theme this week.

consider.text: Use the cleared framing: firm goal, pragmatic pathway.

publicInfo.text: Singapore has publicly committed to net zero by 2050; specifics of any updated near-term target should come from cleared statements, not speculation.

engagements.title: High Ambition Coalition Meeting

engagements.watchPoint: Avoid signing onto any collective finance pledge on the coalition's behalf.
engagements.ifAsked: Singapore supports ambition and can help broker, but keeps its own finance envelope.

anticipated.q: Will Singapore co-sign a coalition statement calling for a finance figure?

engagements.watchPoint: Do not trade away integrity safeguards for a faster deal.
engagements.ifAsked: Singapore wants an outcome, but only one that protects environmental integrity.
